user.description: Connect a NibePi that publishes heat pump registers to your MQTT broker. Enable MQTT in the NibePi Node-RED UI first.

data_description.base_topic: MQTT topic prefix configured in NibePi (default: nibe/modbus/).
data_description.lwt_topic: Topic NibePi uses for its last will (default: nibe). Leave empty to disable availability tracking.

confirm.description: A NibePi was found publishing on {base_topic}. Do you want to add it?

error.invalid_topic: Topics must not contain MQTT wildcards (+, #), and the base topic must not be empty.

data_description.language: Language for states such as operating mode, alarms or pump status. Automatic uses the Home Assistant language, or Norwegian if it is not supported.
data_description.model: Shown on the device. Automatic detects it from the registers NibePi sends (detected: {detected_model}). It does not change which entities exist.

value_not_writable.message: {value} cannot be written exactly to {entity}: NibePi would store a different value. Choose a value one step lower or higher.
